title: Canada News Quiz - Week of September 10, 2026
description: Unpublished research draft covering Canadian headlines, culture, health, and sport.

questions.prompt: Which portrait appears on the new Canadian $20 note unveiled on September 3?
questions.explanation: The Bank of Canada unveiled a new vertical $20 note featuring King Charles III. It is expected to enter circulation in February 2027.

questions.prompt: What overnight interest rate did the Bank of Canada hold on September 2?
questions.explanation: The Bank of Canada held its target for the overnight rate at 2.25%.

questions.prompt: Canadian counter-tariffs taking effect on September 8 applied to listed products from which country?
questions.explanation: The Finance Department listed products from the United States subject to counter-tariffs effective September 8.

questions.prompt: What emergency medicine did Food Allergy Canada call on schools to keep in stock this week?
questions.explanation: Food Allergy Canada called for provincial laws requiring schools to stock epinephrine devices for severe allergic reactions, beyond devices assigned to individual students.

questions.prompt: Which Canadian city welcomed the international film festival opening on September 10?
questions.explanation: The Toronto International Film Festival opened on September 10. The 2026 festival runs through September 20.

questions.prompt: Which summer program offering free admission at Parks Canada sites ended after Labour Day?
questions.explanation: The Canada Strong Pass summer offer ran through September 7. Regular Parks Canada fees resumed on September 8.

questions.prompt: The federal government announced matching donations to a Red Cross flood appeal for which Prairie province on September 4?
questions.explanation: The federal announcement matched eligible donations to the Canadian Red Cross 2026 Manitoba Flood Appeal, supporting recovery from summer flooding.

questions.prompt: Which CFL team came back to beat Calgary in the Labour Day Classic on September 7?
questions.explanation: The Edmonton Elks rallied in the fourth quarter to defeat the Calgary Stampeders in the Labour Day game.
